content: Letter 7, to Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad, i.e., Shaykh al-Islām Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad b. Saʿd al-Dīn Taftāzānī: a letter of greeting to this prominent member of Herat's religious establishment (TMN/MS p. 4; MK cross-refers to letter 3). MK's footnote adds that it is unlikely to be Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad Jazarī, who became one of his most implacable enemies.
